steps.label: BRANCH

steps.label: REMOTE
steps.sub: A hosted copy of the repo, e.g. GitHub

eyebrow: A typical change, start to finish
code:
git clone <repo-url>              # copy the repo to your own machine
git checkout -b fix-report-filter # create and switch to a new branch
# ...make your changes...
git add .                         # stage the changed files
git commit -m "Fix date filter on regional report"
git push origin fix-report-filter # send the branch to the remote
caption: From here, a pull request asks a teammate to review before it merges.
